title: telemetry-server client protocol, version 1
description: Every message is one JSON object on one line (UTF-8, terminated by a newline). The 'type' key selects the definition of the same name in $defs.

n.description: Identifying number of a point of data received, in order.

t_ms.description: Milliseconds since the session started, on the server's monotonic clock.

data.description: All the telemetry data at a single point in time for a single machine and / or stage.

values.description: Field name to value, already converted to the unit announced in 'hello'.

samples.description: All the rocket's data between two points in time.

hello.description: Server to client, once, first message on every connection.

session.description: Identifies one run of the server. Sample numbers are only meaningful within one session.

fields.description: Every field name that can appear in 'values', with its unit (null when it has none).

error.description: Server to client. 'bad_message': the client's last line was not a valid message. 'internal': the server failed while answering.

get.description: Client to server. Asks for the samples with from_n <= n < to_n.
